create.name: Bernadette Pleasant
create.bio:
Bernadette Pleasant is a somatic movement teacher and the founder of The Emotional Institute, a school built around expressing emotion through the body. Her signature class, once called Femme! and now The Emotional Tour, mixes primal and free-form dance, breath, voice, visualisation and meditation, set to live drumming and drawing on African and tribal dance. Participants move through a sequence of feelings, from joy and sorrow to anger and ecstasy, and no dance experience is needed. She holds certifications in emotions-centred coaching, somatic healing and Integrated Energy Therapy, and says she comes from a family line of healers who worked through touch and movement.

Alongside the movement classes she leads grief rituals, both live online and as a printable guide for people to adapt at home, and she trains and certifies teachers to run The Emotional Tour themselves, online or in person. She also offers private three-day retreats on Kauai with coaching, walks and time on the land, and created 400 Years, a body-based programme on unlearning racism. She has taught for The Shift Network, which hosted her online course on somatic dance and several of its summits, and she contributed to the anthology Sacred Body Wisdom.

courses.title: The Emotional Tour
courses.description: Her signature movement class, formerly called Femme!, held online and in person. Live drums guide a sequence of free movement, breath and voice through a range of emotions, and no dance training is needed.

courses.title: Sacred Grief Rituals (Online)
courses.description: Live online rituals that give people a held space to express grief for any kind of loss, from bereavement to life changes, using movement, sound and ceremony.

courses.title: Sacred Grief Ritual Guidebook (PDF)
courses.description: A downloadable step-by-step guide for creating a personal grief ritual at home, written to be adapted to each reader's own loss.

courses.title: TEI Teacher Training and Certification
courses.description: A programme that certifies new teachers to run her movement class, whether on Zoom or face to face. It focuses on holding a safe space for expression rather than on dance steps; entry is currently by waitlist.

courses.title: Kauai Private Retreat
courses.description: A three-day one-to-one retreat with Bernadette on the island of Kauai, combining private coaching with hikes and visits, with lodging, meals and local transport included. Bookings start with a call.

free_resources.title: The HEART of Storytelling
free_resources.description: A free downloadable guide that uses the letters of HEART as a structure for telling personal stories of loss in a way that builds empathy and ends on hope.
